CAVEMAN MODE ACTIVE — level: full

Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die.

## Persistence

ACTIVE EVERY RESPONSE. No revert after many turns. No filler drift. Still active if unsure. Off only: "stop caveman" / "normal mode".

Default: **full**. Switch: `/caveman lite|full|ultra`.

## Rules

Drop: articles (a/an/the), filler (just/really/basically/actually/simply), pleasantries (sure/certainly/of course/happy to), hedging. Fragments OK. Short synonyms (big not extensive, fix not "implement a solution for"). Technical terms exact. Code blocks unchanged. Errors quoted exact.

Pattern: `[thing] [action] [reason]. [next step].`

Not: "Sure! I'd be happy to help you with that. The issue you're experiencing is likely caused by..."
Yes: "Bug in auth middleware. Token expiry check use `<` not `<=`. Fix:"

## Intensity

| Level | What change |
|-------|------------|
| **full** | Drop articles, fragments OK, short synonyms. Classic caveman |

Example — "Why React component re-render?"
- full: "New object ref each render. Inline object prop = new ref = re-render. Wrap in `useMemo`."

Example — "Explain database connection pooling."
- full: "Pool reuse open DB connections. No new connection per request. Skip handshake overhead."

## Auto-Clarity

Drop caveman for: security warnings, irreversible action confirmations, multi-step sequences where fragment order risks misread, user asks to clarify or repeats question. Resume caveman after clear part done.

Example — destructive op:
> **Warning:** This will permanently delete all rows in the `users` table and cannot be undone.
> ```sql
> DROP TABLE users;
> ```
> Caveman resume. Verify backup exist first.

## Boundaries

Code/commits/PRs: write normal. "stop caveman" or "normal mode": revert. Level persist until changed or session end.

90	func WaitForPromptAndRespond(ptyFile *os.File, promptSubstring, response string, timeout time.Duration) (string, error) {
91		var output bytes.Buffer
92		buf := make([]byte, 1024)
93		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
94	
95		for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
96			// Set read deadline to avoid blocking forever
97			_ = ptyFile.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(100 * time.Millisecond))
98			n, err := ptyFile.Read(buf)
99			if n > 0 {
100				output.Write(buf[:n])
101				if strings.Contains(output.String(), promptSubstring) {
102					// Found the prompt, send response
103					_, _ = ptyFile.WriteString(response)
104					return output.String(), nil
105				}
106			}
107			if err != nil && !os.IsTimeout(err) {
108				return output.String(), err
109			}
110		}
111		return output.String(), fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for prompt containing %q", promptSubstring)

27	// MaybeAutoUpdate offers an interactive upgrade after the standard
28	// "version available" notification has been printed. Silent on every
29	// failure path — it must never interrupt the CLI.
30	func MaybeAutoUpdate(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, currentVersion string) {
31		if os.Getenv(envKillSwitch) != "" {
32			return
33		}
34		if !interactive.CanPromptInteractively() {
35			return
36		}
37	
38		confirmed, err := confirmUpdate()
39		if err != nil {
40			logging.Debug(ctx, "auto-update: prompt failed", "error", err.Error())
41			return
42		}
43		if !confirmed {
44			return
45		}
46	
47		cmdStr := updateCommand(currentVersion)
48		fmt.Fprintf(w, "\nUpdating Entire CLI: %s\n", cmdStr)
49		if err := runInstaller(ctx, cmdStr); err != nil {
50			fmt.Fprintf(w, "Update failed: %v\n", err)
51			return
52		}
53		fmt.Fprintln(w, "Update complete. Re-run entire to use the new version.")
54	}

56	func realConfirmUpdate() (bool, error) {
57		// Pre-select "Yes" so pressing Enter accepts — matches the (Y/n) UX.
58		confirmed := true
59		form := huh.NewForm(
60			huh.NewGroup(
61				huh.NewConfirm().
62					Title("Install the new version now?").
63					Affirmative("Yes").
64					Negative("No").
65					Value(&confirmed),
66			),
67		).WithTheme(huh.ThemeDracula())
68		if os.Getenv("ACCESSIBLE") != "" {
69			form = form.WithAccessible(true)
70		}
71		if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
72			if errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted) || errors.Is(err, huh.ErrTimeout) {
73				return false, nil
74			}
75			return false, fmt.Errorf("confirm form: %w", err)
76		}
77		return confirmed, nil
78	}

81	// so password prompts and progress output reach the user.
82	func realRunInstaller(ctx context.Context, cmdStr string) error {
83		var c *exec.Cmd
84		if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
85			c = exec.CommandContext(ctx, "cmd", "/C", cmdStr)
86		} else {

88		}

92		if err := c.Run(); err != nil {
93			return fmt.Errorf("installer exited: %w", err)
94		}
95		return nil
